claims.text: Machine-learning potentials should be integrated with ab initio molecular-dynamics simulations.
The integrated method could improve determination of the solid-to-fluid transition temperature.
The integrated method could improve determination of fusion enthalpy.
The integrated method could improve determination of fusion entropy.
The integrated method could improve determination of the volume change at the transition.
The integrated method could improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity.
Integrating machine-learning potentials with ab initio simulations would improve predictive accuracy relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Integrating machine-learning potentials with ab initio simulations would improve computational efficiency.
The proposed integration improves predictions by better capturing complex interactions within high-entropy alloys.
The proposed method is applicable to multicomponent high-entropy materials in high-temperature states.
Performance depends on developing and validating suitable machine-learning potentials for high-entropy alloys.
